meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 Biopython 处理生物序列（DNA/RNA/蛋白质）、读写 FASTA/GenBank 等文件、查询 NCBI 数据库、运行 BLAST 搜索、进行序列比对、分析蛋白质结构、构建进化树等。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理生物序列、操作基因文件、查询 NCBI 数据库或进行 BLAST 搜索时触发。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use Biopython to manipulate biological sequences (DNA/RNA/protein), read/write formats like FASTA/GenBank, query NCBI databases, run BLAST searches, perform sequence alignments, analyze protein structures, and build phylogenetic trees.
